spans.s:
√pan 'admire'
present: [1.] pánanta 
perfect: papana papné 
aorist: [5.] paniṣṭa (3s.) 
verbal: panitá 
secondary: passive: panyáte -- intensive: pánipnat -- causative: panáyati panáyate etc. 
derivatives: pana- pánya RV.K. panā́yya RV.AB. panas- RV. panú RV. panitṛ́ RV. paniṣṭama SV. pániṣṭi SV. pániṣṭha V.B. pánīyas V. pányas RV. -panyā RV. -panyu RV. panayā́yya RV. 
The words paṇya S., paṇā́yya ŚB. seem to belong in meaning to this root.
